$comment: Every KeeperHub surface this project touches, with the evidence that backs it.
Labels are deliberately narrow. LIVE_PROVEN means a real request hit app.keeperhub.com in this
project and the response is recorded in proof-output/. FIXTURE_PROVEN means the code path is
exercised only against packages/keeperhub/test/fakeServer.ts. A surface can be LIVE_PROVEN and
still have failed - see execute.contract-call, which really ran and really returned an error.
Nothing here is inferred from documentation.

chain.name: Base Sepolia
chain.sponsorship: KeeperHub sponsors gas for transfers (sponsored: true). It does NOT sponsor contract-calls (sponsored: false). This asymmetry is the single reason the contract deploy through KeeperHub failed and why executeSettlement has never run onchain.

surfaces.notes: Used only to confirm the key is accepted before anything is spent. Response body is never logged.
Gate before execution. If the chain is absent or disabled the flight aborts rather than guessing.

observed.source: scripts/first-flight.mjs:171 runs simulate() inside the shared leg runner before every execute; the transfer leg at :243 proceeded to execution, which the runner only does when simulate returns HTTP < 400 AND success === true

surfaces.notes: Simulation is the same POST with simulate:true in the body, not a separate endpoint. A non-throwing simulate is a hard precondition for execute.
Two separate zero-value flights on two separate runs, not one receipt cited twice. Both were chain-verified independently of KeeperHub's own status field.

observed.source: scripts/first-flight.mjs:171 via the deploy leg at :259. The leg reached execution and produced executionId egx3sar8ahsaz741j8nr4, which is only reachable after simulate() returns success === true

surfaces.notes: Worth stating plainly: simulation passed and execution still failed. Simulation does not model the relayer's own native-token balance.

observed.errorVerbatim: Insufficient BASE balance. Have: 0.0, Need: 0.000000231. Fund 0x7ae891ec51990684682a084381e97b59d787652b with at least 0.000000231 BASE on this chain and retry.

surfaces.notes: The request surface itself is proven - KeeperHub accepted the call and returned a real executionId that polled to a real terminal state. What is unproven is a SUCCESSFUL contract-call. The contract was subsequently deployed by other means; see docs/release/truth-snapshot.md.

observed.outcome: polled to terminal for all three executions above (two completed, one failed)

surfaces.notes: Terminal detection uses both the status field and the X-Poll-Interval-Hint === 0 signal.

protocolBehaviours.behaviour: sleep 1000ms, retry, bounded at 5 attempts, then throw
treat the original id as the answer and poll it, rather than re-submitting
throw with canonicalization guidance - the same key was reused with a different body, so silently retrying would be wrong

protocolBehaviours.trigger: X-Poll-Interval-Hint header on a status response
protocolBehaviours.behaviour: wait exactly that many seconds before the next poll; 0 means terminal, stop polling
protocolBehaviours.liveObserved: hint was honoured during the live flights, but the per-poll header values were not captured in the proof JSON, so this is labelled fixture-proven rather than claimed as measured

protocolBehaviours.behaviour: pause exactly the advertised duration, then resume polling; never spin faster than the server asks
protocolBehaviours.notes: No live 429 was ever triggered. That is a good outcome, not a gap in the client.

notExercised.reason: Out of autonomous scope. No value-bearing mainnet transaction was broadcast at any point.
Relayer 0x7ae891ec51990684682a084381e97b59d787652b holds zero native BASE and KeeperHub does not sponsor contract-call gas.
